```yaml
name: Claude PR Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  claude-review:
    if: |
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && !github.event.pull_request.draft) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && github.event.issue.pull_request && contains(github.event.comment.body, '/review-pr'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run Claude PR Review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          prompt: |
            You are a helpful code reviewer. Please review the changes in this pull request.
            Focus on:
            1. Code quality and best practices
            2. Potential bugs or issues
            3. Security concerns
            4. Performance implications
            5. Documentation clarity
            
            Provide constructive feedback and suggestions for improvement.
            If the changes look good, provide a brief summary of what was changed and why it's an improvement.
```
